articles.summary: Vancouver, British Columbia – Integra Resources Corp. (“Integra” or the “Company”) (TSXV: ITR; NYSE American: ITRG) is pleased to announce additional results from the growth and expansion drill program at the Company’s producing Florida Canyon Mine (“Florida Canyon” or the “Mine”) located in Nevada. The results announced today continue to demonstrate the potential to further expand the gold resource at […]
articles.title: Integra Identifies New Near-Mine Gold Growth Targets at Florida Canyon, including 1.30 g/t Au over 62.5 m and 0.59 g/t Au over 167.6 m Inter-Pit and 0.48 g/t Au over 54.9 m in New Madre Shear North Target - Integra Resources
